title: Dismissing the Reopen window with Esc does nothing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, closed.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  4. Click "Reopen Work Order".
  5. Press Esc.
  6. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The document shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reopen Work Order".

Step 4:

  • The window opens.

Step 5:

  • The window stays open.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the work order is still Closed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-R2: “Reopen opens the dialog "Reopen work order [number]?" with the body "The work order leaves Closed · Internal and goes back to Complete. The parts cost and shop supplies entries are reversed in your books." (Closed · No Charge on a no-charge one) and the buttons Cancel and "Reopen Work Order". Dismissing the dialog in any other way does nothing.”
